evidence: Rewrites core logging macros and utilities across src/util/log.h and src/logging.cpp.
rationale: This refactor modernizes logging macro infrastructure by replacing opaque expansion failures with clear static_assert error messages and eliminating formatting overhead when logging is disabled. The author notes static assertions catch cases like 'Missing required category argument for Debug/Trace logging call' at compile time and eliminate 'unnecessary strprintf calls in fuzzing and kernel applications'.
